text:
**Best all-in-one kit for longer van trips: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200W solar panel.** It bundles the panel and gives you **2,073.6Wh** of capacity—more reserve for a 12V fridge, laptop, and other essentials than a compact power station. One listing puts it at **$1,199**; its estimate of several days’ runtime depends on your actual usage and sunlight. ([Kit details and buy link](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-for-van-life))

If **weight and space matter more**, look at the **Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2**: it weighs **24.9 lb**, has **1,024Wh** capacity, and accepts up to **600W of solar input**. That’s the van-focused pick in a 2026 comparison, though the results don’t establish that it comes as a panel-included kit. ([Comparison and specs](https://powersized.com/best/rv/))

**Bottom line:** choose the BLUETTI bundle for more battery capacity and a panel included; choose the Anker for a lighter setup.

judge.top_pick: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
products: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
